headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy as the company's board opened an investigation and Trump defended him, while ChinaTalk argued the AI-driven 'cyberpocalypse' might hit China harder and Freedom House charted 'seismic shifts' on the global internet.

points.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to a romantic relationship with Alice Huang, an AI executive reportedly recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to spy on him; Nvidia's board launched an independent investigation, and President Trump defended Huang over the weekend.
ChinaTalk examined why the 'cyberpocalypse' sparked by AI-discovered PHP vulnerabilities might hit China harder than the US.
Tech Policy Press covered Freedom House's annual Freedom on the Net report, which found 'seismic shifts' affecting the global internet.
